## What is a Vendor Package?

A vendor package contains device-specific components required for proper operation of the ROM, including:

- Device configuration
- Hardware support files
- Camera components
- Audio components
- Radio / modem interfaces
- Samsung-specific libraries

## Known Vendor Packages

| Version | OneUI Base      | Status        |
|----------|-----------     |---------------|
| v8.6.2 Vendor | OneUI 8.5 | Archived      |

## Notes

- Always use the vendor package recommended for your LumiROM release.
- Mismatched vendor versions may cause bootloops, crashes, or missing features.
- Verify checksums before flashing when available.

## Preservation Status

Community members are encouraged to contribute:

- Vendor packages
- Checksums
- Installation instructions
- Screenshots
- Original release notes

Please open an Issue or Pull Request if you have missing files.
